claim_under_pricing: Before any population training, audit whether the canonical obs72 normalization constants remain in range when current-sim vehicle parameters and high-speed context are stressed. This is a zero-training distribution measurement and recommendation artifact only; it does not apply a normalization change.

seed_discipline.disjointness: new seed base and episode seed stream are disjoint from C5 selection and validation streams; this audit has no training, selection, or validation split.

S4_proxy_stress.scope_note: current-sim stress proxy only; not a validated passenger-fleet physics model

profiles.mid_obstacle_arc: R=60 m obstacle arc, speed target 16 m/s, curvature-compensated static obstacle, v4 scripted control
profiles.high_speed_arc: R=250 m no-obstacle arc, speed target 28 m/s, v4 scripted control; included to expose vx/20 and preview-time risk before B2
profiles.figure8_context: R=45 figure-eight no-obstacle context, speed target 14 m/s, v4 scripted control

observed_channels.contract: canonical obs72 with history_length=1, action_history_mode=full, road_lookahead_count=8, obstacle_slots=4

preregistered_readouts.per_channel: min, max, p01, p50, p99, max_abs, p99_abs, frac_abs_gt_0.8, frac_abs_gt_1.0, frac_abs_gt_1.5, frac_abs_gt_2.0
preregistered_readouts.per_group: max p99_abs, max frac_abs_gt_1.0, worst channel
preregistered_readouts.preview_time: road lookahead distance 8*5 m divided by profile speed, plus preview distance needed for 2.5 s
preregistered_readouts.decision_rule: A2 is complete if it reports channel saturation/shift tables and a frozen recommendation. A channel is flagged if p99_abs > 0.9 or frac_abs_gt_1.0 > 0.01. Recommendations are advisory only and cannot admit training without a follow-up implementation milestone.

claim_boundary: Observation-normalization audit only. Zero training. No normalization change applied. No driver mutation, driver-performance, validation ranking, promotion, high-fidelity sufficiency, paper, repair-success, robustness-result, feasibility-proof, or self-ID claim.
